# Generated by build_integration.py. Do not edit.

on_startup = {
	events = { jxp_a_socioeconomic_integration.1 }
}

# A failed transaction receives one one-day retry from event .2 and thereafter
# only this bounded yearly retry.  There is no monthly or world scan.
on_yearly_pulse = {
	events = { jxp_a_socioeconomic_integration.1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_country_modifier = jxp_three_capitals_ledgers
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_106_three_capitals_ledgers_converted }
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_modifier = jxp_a_buddhist_temple_credit
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_106_buddhist_temple_credit_converted }
				}
			}
		}
		jxp_a_106_convert_legacy_permanent_rewards_effect = yes
	}
}

on_religion_change = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes jxp_a_106_has_any_socioeconomic_state_trigger = yes } }
		jxp_a_reconcile_socioeconomic_system_effect = yes
	}
}

on_government_change = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes jxp_a_106_has_any_socioeconomic_state_trigger = yes } }
		jxp_a_reconcile_socioeconomic_system_effect = yes
	}
}
